## Manual admission schema

Supply `onboarding_admission` JSON with exactly these fields. This unusable
example is a declaration schema, not authority or an allocated clock:

```json
{
  "scope": "Q04c-on-final-post648-P-onboarding-only",
  "controller_sha": "<reviewed consumer full SHA>",
  "allocation_id": "<Root one-case allocation>",
  "attempt": 1,
  "retries": 0,
  "manifest_sha256": "<verified actual producer manifest SHA256>",
  "producer": {
    "run_id": 0,
    "artifact_id": 0,
    "controller_sha": "<reviewed new producer full SHA>",
    "branch": "<reviewed new producer branch>",
    "artifact_name": "<verified exact artifact name>"
  },
  "clock": {
    "STARTED": 0,
    "WORK_DEADLINE": 0,
    "CLEANUP_DEADLINE": 0,
    "HARD_DEADLINE": 0
  }
}
```

package/output/download locations are fixed disjoint job-owned paths. The case
